summary: Ubisoft's H.A.W.X branch is a Tom Clancy arcade flight-combat series tied into the Ghost Recon/EndWar fiction and split across PC, HD consoles, and mobile versions.

entries.title: Tom Clancy's H.A.W.X
entries.definitive_edition: Xbox 360 physical disc through official backward compatibility, with owned PC copy documented separately if used

emulation.notes: Use official Xbox backward compatibility or native owned PC build.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Xbox backward-compatible console route for current official access; native PC for labeled settings comparison

primary.platform: Xbox 360 disc on Xbox One / Xbox Series backward compatibility
primary.version: Official backward-compatible console route where available
primary.why: The original HD console/PC game is now easiest to preserve through physical Xbox 360 media with official backward compatibility, while the PC version can offer higher settings if already owned but is not a dependable current purchase route.
primary.how_to_play: Use a physical Xbox 360 copy through Xbox backward compatibility, or an owned PC copy for settings/capture comparison. Record media/source, platform, patch state, controller/flight-stick setup, mission, difficulty, assistance/ERS settings, aircraft unlocks, co-op/multiplayer availability, and DLC/online status.

secondary.exclusive_content: Higher settings and PC input options if already owned
secondary.what_to_play: Use as a capture/settings route when an owned copy is available.
secondary.why: PC can be cleaner technically, but current storefront availability is unreliable/delisted.
They are not equivalent to the HD console/PC route.

all_releases.fidelity: Original HD console arcade flight-combat route.
all_releases.reason: primary: original console route and, on Xbox, current physical backward-compatible path.

all_releases.fidelity: PC route with higher settings and compatibility fixes if already owned.
all_releases.reason: secondary: strong capture route but availability/online state must be verified.

all_releases.platform: iOS / Android / BlackBerry / Palm Pre / Symbian

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Xbox backward compatibility preserves a current official console path, while PC and mobile availability/content differ.

entries.remaster_caveats: Verify marketplace/disc/backward-compatibility status before the run; PC multiplayer/DLC availability may differ from launch-era behavior.
